resources.string: Searching for computers on your local network…\n\nMake sure Sunshine is running on your PC and that the phone and the PC are on the same Wi-Fi.
The PC returned an HTTP 404 error. Make sure Sunshine is up to date and running. Remote desktop software can also cause this error. Try restarting the PC or reinstalling Sunshine.
Sunshine receives the phone\'s resolution and FPS. Without it the PC will not change its screen resolution.
